verdict.rationale: Reflect exposes a basic REST API (OAuth2/PKCE, append text, deep links) for integrations, but there is no documented plugin/extension architecture or SDK with samples for building custom plugins — community feedback even highlights that Reflect deliberately avoids a plugin system ('fully functional without any plugins'), unlike competitors such as Obsidian. Probes for openapi/SDK docs also return 404s, reinforcing the absence of a plugin developer platform.
